description: Every 5 minutes on weekdays, checks each payroll client's cut-off timers (set in Knowledge, Payroll/clients.json) in the client's time zone. Before the due time it saves a reminder email in your Outlook Drafts and opens a WorkQ item; if nothing has arrived by the follow-up time (default 30 min after due) it saves a follow-up draft; at the escalation time (default 60 min) it adds the payroll owner; at the hard cut-off it notes that anything later goes into the next pay run. The item closes itself when the client's payroll email arrives (seen by the email intake) or when someone marks it done. Drafts only: it never sends email.
